relationship_to_historical_target: Separate bounded extension: top-level user-defined functions, flat parameter/species assignment and rate rules, Boolean/conditional operators, and numeric functions extend beyond frozen kinetic-core-v0.1; old corpus reuse is not target conformance.

syntax.function_definitions: Top-level function name(param1, param2, ...) body end blocks before, within (anonymous models), or after model declarations; optional star prefix function *name(...) and model *name(...); optional trailing semicolon after body expression or end.
syntax.function_calls: Exact-arity user-defined function calls in parameter/species initializers, assignment/rate rules, reaction kinetic laws, and subsequent user-defined function bodies.
syntax.empty_function_rejections: Empty function bodies (function f(x) end or function f(x) ; end) reject UnsupportedFeature; never silently emit empty lambdas.
syntax.scoping_and_recursion_rejections: Function bodies may only reference their formal parameters, mathematical constants (pi, exponentiale), numeric/Boolean/conditional builtins, and previously declared user functions. Forward calls reject UnsupportedFeature; direct recursion, time/time() inside function bodies, and free model symbol references inside function bodies reject DeclarationConflict.

semantics.namespace_and_ordering: Function definitions export in source declaration order to <listOfFunctionDefinitions> with <lambda> and <bvar><ci>...</ci></bvar>. Function identifiers share a flat namespace with model name, compartments, species, parameters, reactions, and unit definitions (collisions reject DeclarationConflict).
semantics.initialization_evaluation: Parameter and species initializers calling user-defined functions evaluate iteratively across parameter frames when all arguments are known finite values; unknown arguments propagate None cleanly unless short-circuited by logical/piecewise operators; domain/divide-by-zero/nonfinite errors inside called functions reject DeclarationConflict.
semantics.constancy_and_dependencies: Static dependency analysis traverses call-site arguments for cycle detection, parameter constancy propagation, and reaction modifier discovery. Assignment-rule targets still populate SBML scalar attributes only for verified lexical finite bare numeric/-numeric forms, never for function calls.
semantics.dimensions: Call-site argument DimensionalStatus values are substituted into the called function body iteratively to verify internal dimensional consistency and return-dimension compatibility with annotated targets.

retained_exclusions: Forward/out-of-order function calls and recursive or mutually recursive functions
Compartment expression initialization (including compartment C = f(...)) and compartment assignment/rate rules
Reaction assignment rules replacing kinetic laws, algebraic rules (0 = expr), and empty rule clearing (a := ;)
All textual infix/prefix logical aliases, comparison chains, XOR, and implies
Nonfinite constants and existing scalar/rational restrictions
A solver or general simulation-readiness guarantee
